data.name: Armina
data.gender_notes: Armina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Ar-Ra-Mana' meaning high, exalted, or sublime. In Islamic history, Ar-Rahman is one of the 99 names of Allah, signifying the All-Gentle, All-Compassionate, and All-Merciful God. The name Armina carries the meaning “Exalted, sublime” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Armina usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, sublime and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carrying the grace and blessings of the All-Compassionate and All-Merciful Allah.
data.etymology: Armina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, sublime.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Armina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
